posts.title: Another Day, Another Ruby Framework to Play in
posts.description: Hanami 3.0 has dropped and can I just say, the docs are gorgeous. I love the bold fun rebrand and their positive encouraging attitude. I first stumbled upon it after giving BrutRB a spin and ultimately deciding to let it mature for a bit before I return, but feeling the itch to keep going with ruby. JavaScript all day every day can be a bit dull. So, to scratch the itch and prepare for using LLMs

posts.title: New-to-me Blonde Ales, loosely ranked
posts.description: This is my subjective list. They were all baseline tasty beers. New favorite: Melvin, Killer Bees Close second: Jeremiah Johnson Brewing Co, Blonde Ale Middle of the pack: Maui, Bikini Blonde Pelican, Sunrise Surfer Blonde Cascade Lakes Brewing Co, Blonde Bombshell Not my favorite: Belching Beaver, Must Be the Honey Firestone Walker 805 A fun Mother's Day treat. Cheers.

posts.title: A shiny new ruby framework
posts.description: Happy performance review season to all who celebrate. I've been kicking around BrutRB in an attempt to remember anything other than Javascript. I like the idea of fewer abstractions. The DC Metro styling is fun and nostalgic, very human. The maintainer also created an ai declaration policy . I can fully get on board with that.
